title: Power shutoff customer notice (warning, power off, restoration, cancellation, all clear)
description: A utility notice to customers during a public safety power shutoff: which notice window it is (48-72 hours before, 24-48 hours before, 1-4 hours before, at de-energization, restoration or cancellation), what is happening and why, the circuits and times, what to do, a message for medical baseline customers and the community resource center. The variant sets the situation (warning, power off, restoration, cancellation or all clear).

examples: Power may be shut off Saturday evening to reduce wildfire risk

message.description: What is happening and why, in plain words.
examples: Strong winds and very dry conditions are forecast. We may turn off power on your circuit to reduce the chance of a wildfire.

powerOff.description: When power may go off, or went off.

powerOn.description: When power is expected back, or what it depends on.
examples: We expect power back by midday Sunday after crews inspect lines.

circuits.description: Circuits or areas affected, in words.
examples: Circuit C-114: Cinder Canyon and Ridgeview
Charge phones and medical devices, fill prescriptions, fill your vehicle with fuel and plan for several days without power.
If you rely on power for a medical need, call 555-0100 now. In an emergency call 911.
Calloway High School gym, 8 AM to 8 PM Sunday: charging, water, restrooms.
